verdict.rationale: Name.com documents a TLD price list API endpoint that returns every supported TLD alphabetically, with pricing for each supported order type. It exposes three pricing tiers (account-level, original, retail), and the availability check also returns per-domain pricing, so tooling can compare and budget programmatically. Missing for 10: the docs excerpts never explicitly name registration, renewal and transfer as the order types, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the feed's freshness or completeness.

support.subject: As a developer, pricing is machine-readable — an API or feed returns current registration/renewal/transfer prices per TLD so tooling can compare and budget

citations.quote: This endpoint returns an alphabetical list of all TLDs supported by name.com, including pricing for each supported order type.
name.com provides three pricing types for each TLD: Account-Level Pricing... Original Pricing... Retail Pricing (Public Site Pricing)
Checks whether up to 50 domain names are purchasable and returns **discovery** pricing for each result.
